patch.description:
Requires `CATEGORY_UPDATE`. Up to 100 ids, one transaction, **all-or-nothing**: if any category is blocked nothing is saved and the 409 lists every blocker. Categories already in the target status are returned in `unchangedIds`. Children and parents included in the same request never block each other. Send `dryRun: true` to get the plan and blockers without saving.

- Leaving ACTIVE (→ INACTIVE / ARCHIVED):
  - Products (incl. soft-deleted) or store listings use it → blocked (`inUse`), unless `moveProductsTo` is sent: they are reassigned to that ACTIVE category first.
  - Child categories not part of the change → blocked (`hasChildren`), unless `detachChildren: true`: their parent is removed and they become root categories.
  - At least one ACTIVE category must remain (`minimumRequired`).
- Becoming ACTIVE: the parent must be ACTIVE (or part of the same bulk request) (`parentNotActive`). `moveProductsTo` is not allowed.
- INACTIVE ↔ ARCHIVED: no checks.

Recommended UI flow: try the change (or `dryRun` in bulk) → on `inUse` blockers ask the admin for a target category → resend with `moveProductsTo`; on `hasChildren` offer to include the children or resend with `detachChildren: true`.

A snapshot of the catalogue data is stored on each listing; the original product is never modified. Returns the product view. Statuses: DRAFT (prepared, never shown), SCHEDULED (goes ACTIVE automatically at `publishAt`, checked every minute), ACTIVE (live), INACTIVE (switched off). ACTIVE / SCHEDULED need the admin catalogue item to be live (PUBLISHED product, active variant) — otherwise 400 CATALOG_NOT_LIVE. `publishAt` must be at least 1 minute ahead. **OTHER** = any extra document (several allowed, up to 10, `title` required). It never counts toward the required set.

ACTIVE groups by `position`, each with its ACTIVE categories in the group's order, names in `Accept-Language`. Groups without an active category are left out. Cached; changes show within seconds.

Requires `storeId`. Supports search (`q`), `categoryIds` and `groupIds` (category groups; both include sub-categories), `brandIds` (comma-separated or repeated; one value per filter type is OR-ed, filter types are AND-ed) and sort (`new`, `price_asc`, `price_desc`). Paginated per product; `hasMore` tells whether another page exists.
